message.content:
Hey gardeners, heads up about some dirt-shoveling drama this coming weekend. We’ve got a nagging leak in the main water pipe near the north gate, so we’re shutting that entrance down on Saturday, April 18, from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm to get it patched up. Don't worry, you can still get in—just haul your wheelbarrows around to the east entrance instead. 

Now, because of all the ruckus, we’re pushing our big spring seed swap to Sunday at 11:00 am. Honestly, Sunday morning is a much better vibe for trading heirloom tomato seeds anyway, isn't it? 

If you’re coming out to help us dig, repair, or tidy up the beds during the Saturday chaos, please remember to bring your own work gloves. We’ve got plenty of shovels and tools ready to go, so you can leave yours at home. 

Mina is coordinating our volunteer crew for the day, so give her a shout when you arrive to find out where she needs you. Let’s get this pipe fixed so we can keep our veggies happy! See you out in the dirt.
